title: DGG / Goemans cost conjecture: rational counterexample

attribution.proof_route: The fixed upstream source formalizes a finite rational counterexample with seven vertices and nine arcs. It verifies a feasible fractional flow of cost 58 and rules out a routing simultaneously meeting the additive maximum-demand load bound and that cost bound. Discovery and authorship are attributed as reported by the upstream README; they are not independent priority findings. The bridge derives the complete registered rational refutation from the upstream theorem.
attribution.ai_role: The fixed upstream README attributes discovery to a GPT-5.6 Pro session run by Dmitry Rybin and formal verification to Jason Hickey with Claude. These upstream contribution claims remain subject to review. Codex prepared this single-file re-registration; CI prepares source adaptation and the proof bridge; no discovery contribution is claimed for this integration.
attribution.prior_results: The source targets the Goemans cost strengthening in Traub-Vargas Koch-Zenklusen, arXiv:2308.02651v1, Conjecture 1.3, not the separate Dinitz-Garg-Goemans congestion theorem. Upstream reports no axioms beyond propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; this registration claims no additional assumptions, and actual closure auditing is delegated to CI. Statement correspondence uses the recorded administrator exception for dgg-cost/v1; independent mathematical review, discovery date and priority remain unapproved. Related formalization DiscreteAlias/unsplittable-flow uses its own statement catalogue and is not the selected source.
